trans-unit.source: Add a divider wall to hang objects in the middle of the room.
Add a door to a wall, then drag it along that wall to position it. Double-click a door to remove it.
Add a window to this wall - drag to position, double-click to remove
Add a window to this wall - then drag it to position, double-click to remove
Add windows to a wall - they show as glass openings in the 3D walkthrough, inside and out. Works on rectangular and shaped rooms (pick the wall below).

Bring room to front (draw on top of overlapping rooms)
Building — tap a room to enter
Click a corner dot on one room, then a corner dot on another - the second room moves so the corners meet.
Click an object on the canvas to select it.
Click the start point, then the end point.
Click to enter. Move: W A S D. Look: mouse. Select: click an object. Exit: Esc.
Could not build the exhibition from this draft. Please try again.
Could not delete this room (you cannot delete the room you opened the plan from).
Could not draft an exhibition for that theme. Try again or rephrase.
Creates a real Exhibition Space - one room per card above, each object placed - then opens it in the builder.
Delete this room and everything placed in it? This cannot be undone.

Describe a theme. PSIS searches the catalogue and the AI curates a draft exhibition - rooms, a selection of objects, and a one-line label for each. Review it here, then build a real Exhibition Space from the draft.
Doors mark openings on a wall so objects stay clear of them.
Drag rooms to position them; use the corner handles to resize. Upload a blueprint to trace over. Saved automatically; the 3D walkthrough follows this layout.
drag time; rooms shade by conservation status
e.g. women in the liberation struggle, Victorian furniture, WWI letters
Empty = auto. Use 90 / -90 to stand a model upright.
Figures: wheel to pick a person, click to place
Force a fresh AI description: hold G + click an object
Graffiti: click a wall to tag it
Graffiti: tap the spray-can, then click a wall to tag it
Hear description read aloud: hold T (Talk) + click an object
high; drag to position, search to add
Leave blank if not tracking capacity.
Link floors. Add a staircase, drag it onto the plan (place it under the upper-floor room), set which floors it connects. In the 3D walkthrough, walk to it and click the steps to change floor.
Lock this whole floor: align all walls flush (and fill gaps if ticked); rooms can no longer be moved/resized. Click again to unlock the floor.
Make L-shapes or cut corners. Drag a corner; click a + to add one; double-click to remove.
Night mode (walk with the flashlight) - N
Night mode (walk with the flashlight): N or the moon button
No catalogue objects matched that theme. Try different or broader words.
No objects on this wall yet - assign one via "Hang on wall".
No readings in this period yet. Use "Simulate live data" in the Digital Twin Builder, or POST sensor readings to the space readings endpoint.
No readings yet? Open the Digital Twin Builder and use "Simulate live data", or POST sensor readings to the space readings endpoint.
Nothing has been placed in this space yet.
Open info: click an object (or a numbered button)
People in this exhibition right now
Place objects in the open space between rooms. Search to add, then drag the dot. Double-click to remove.
Press H any time for the full controls

Projected from the last 30 days of light readings: annual light dose (lux-hours) vs the material light budget, time until the budget is reached, and visitor load. Budgets follow international museum guidance (very sensitive 50k, sensitive 150k, durable 600k lux-hours/year).
Put this room on a floor. If it is grouped, the whole suite moves with it. Use the Floor dropdown at the top to view one floor at a time.
Regenerate the token? Any sensor using the old token will stop working until updated.
rooms shaded by time spent; red dots = object attention
Rooms that share a wall auto-group and move together (matching dashed outline). Ungroup to move this one on its own.
Selecting an object drops it on the canvas at this size.

Spaces sharing a Building ID become connected rooms you can walk between.
Spotlight: click to cycle off / light on approach / always-on. All modes dim the surroundings as you walk closer.

Stairs must link two DIFFERENT floors. Those rooms are on the same floor - set one to a different floor first (Selected room > Floor), or just place the rooms next to each other for a walk-through doorway.
Stand taller / crouch: hold U + mouse wheel
Stand this 3D model directly on the floor (no pedestal)
Steal (sets off the alarm!): tap the mask, then click an object (or hold S + click)
Steal mode: click an object to trigger the alarm
The blueprint is pinned to the floor plan in metres, so it stays aligned with the rooms when you zoom or add rooms. Click Adjust to drag/resize it onto the rooms.
Then click a spot on the plan where the tour should stand to view this object
The start of digital twins: arrange this collection visually. Search an object, drop it on the floorplan, then drag, rotate and scale it into place. Changes save automatically.
This room is locked. Unlock it first to edit its shape.
Thresholds: temp 16-24 C, humidity 40-60% RH, light <= 200 lux (or the space target).
Torch (light dark corners): F or the bulb button
Touch: drag to look, pinch to zoom, tap an object, tap a numbered button to travel
Virtual reality: tap the VR button (headset required); left stick moves, right stick turns
Walk around this object, then Space or Next to continue
W A S D to walk, mouse to look, click an object for details, Esc to exit
Wheel: change person - click: place (this view only)
When locking, extend walls to close gaps between rooms
Where the guided tour stands to view this object. Best for floor objects - wall art is framed head-on automatically.
Width / Depth / wall Height. Raise H for taller walls.
Windows go on a perimeter wall - pick Back/Front/Left/Right or a numbered wall.
Windows go on perimeter walls, not interior dividers
